learn_confirm.title: Learn Power On
learn_confirm.description: Remote: {remote}. Save as {device} / {command}. Prepare the original AVR remote. Submit, wait for learning mode, then point it at the IR transmitter and press the discrete Power On button within 30 seconds. An existing code with these names will be replaced. No power command is transmitted.

learn_done.title: Learning request completed
learn_done.description: The IR remote finished handling the learning request. Submit to save, then test receiver power-on. The wizard does not inspect the command library or transmit the power command.

learn_failed.title: Learning not confirmed
learn_failed.description: Learning stopped. Remote error type: {error_type}. See the reason below. Submit to choose retry or save without learning. Settings have not been saved.

learn_retry.title: Next action
learn_retry.description: Retry after resolving the error, or save without learning. An unlearned command cannot wake the AVR.

offline.title: Receiver unreachable
offline.description: TCP connection failed. You can save a sleeping receiver with an IR remote, but the address and protocol have not been verified. No wake command will be sent. Submit to save anyway.

progress.learn_power_on: Wait for the transmitter signal or HA notification, then point the original remote at it and press Power On. Waiting up to 30 seconds.

error.learn_remote_off: The IR remote is disabled in HA. Turn on the selected remote entity and retry.
error.learn_remote_unavailable: The IR remote is unavailable. Check its power, network and integration.
error.learn_service_unavailable: remote.learn_command is unavailable. Check that the IR integration is loaded.
error.learn_timeout: Learning timed out. Wait for learning mode and press Power On within 30 seconds.
error.learn_service_failed: The IR integration returned a learning error. Check its log and remote.learn_command.
error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect. Turn on the receiver, check host/port, or select an IR remote.
error.invalid_config: Check the host, name and IR command fields.

abort.already_configured: This host and port are already configured.
